name: Agentic Commerce Readiness Audit
description: A focused audit of a business commerce surface for machine-readable discovery, product data, checkout readiness, fulfillment clarity, and agent-facing purchase friction. Delivered as a practical prioritized report.

fulfillment.input_required: Public commerce URL plus any public product/feed/checkout documentation the customer wants assessed.
fulfillment.output: Prioritized readiness score, evidence-backed blockers, and an implementation action list.
